story_title: How Do AI Agent Kill Switches Actually Work, and Why Most Don't Exist - Startup Fortune

outline.topic: AI agent kill switches
outline.angle: Why relying on a stop button instead of a true kill switch can pose serious security risks in multi-agent systems
supporting_facts: Most startups implement a 'stop button' that asks an AI agent to quit on its next turn, rather than an actual kill switch.
A scenario without containment leads to sub-agents continuing to operate despite the parent being stopped, using old credentials.
With multi-agent containment, all sub-agents stop, and credentials and workflows are paused, requiring human intervention to resume.

post:
startups regularly rely on a 'stop button' for their AI agents, effectively asking them to quit at their convenience. no hard kill switch. 

this creates a risk: sub-agents may keep running even if the main agent is halted, using old credentials unrestricted. 

contrast that with true containment, a solid kill switch halts all sub-agents and pauses credentials, workflows. everything's frozen till a human intervenes. 

in multi-agent systems, the difference between stop and kill is more than semantics. it's a serious security issue.

A true kill switch revokes an AI agent's ability to act immediately.
A scenario without containment leads to sub-agents continuing to operate despite the parent being stopped, using old credentials.
With multi-agent containment, all sub-agents stop, and credentials and workflows are paused, requiring human intervention to resume.

story_title: SAP Business AI: Release Highlights Q2 2026

outline.topic: Voice AI integration in business operations

supporting_facts: A new partnership with LiveKit adds intelligent voice capabilities to Joule.

post:
SAP's recent collaboration with LiveKit is bringing fascinating improvements to the ERP landscape with voice AI. They’re leveraging these capabilities in Joule to transform task management and boost data quality significantly.

Some intriguing points from their rollout:
1. With LiveKit's voice recognition, they anticipate improving data accuracy by 41%—a big win for reducing errors in ERP-related activities.
2. The system aims to cut down correction time in tasks by up to 41%, streamlining operations effectively.
3. SAP Joule, in partnership with LiveKit, has reportedly helped LC Waikiki bring down HR process times by 40-60%, showcasing real-world impact.

Watching these kinds of integrations reminds me how invisible engineering often powers noticeable efficiency and productivity gains in day-to-day business operations.
